messages:
maria: FYI planning thread: LangChain + GateMesh want a joint marketplace listing + a "Certified for Redwood Gateway" badge. Theyre aiming for a soft launch in ~2 weeks. Need alignment on tech checklist, legal, and a lightweight HW perf clip.

arjun: great. what does GateMesh need for the marketplace card? images, short description, integration tags?

maria: yes. short blurb, 2 screenshots, product icon (SVG), integration tags (langchain, llamaindex, gateway). also a 1-line customer quote (can be internal).

olivia: marketing can draft copy. request: give me one clear engineering sentence about what the connector does (30-50 chars).

raj: engineering blurb: "Native LangChain connector for Redwood Gateway, supports streaming and embeddings." good?

olivia: perfect. I'll make short + long variants.

kai: tech Q: GateMesh uses a custom ORCH layer that mutates prompt metadata. we need to ensure our SDK sanitizes headers. i'll open a tiny compatibility PR.

raj: note from testing: LlamaIndex demo index we used before causes token spikes on long docs. recommend shipping with truncated index sample and an embeddings-only sample for marketplace demo.

chloe: legal: partnership terms look fine but we need explicit non-endorsement language and logo usage rules. partners must sign a logo permission form before marketplace publish.

maria: send logo guidelines link to partners: https://partners.redwood.example/logo-policy (partners must return signed form by next Tue).

partner-ops: hw note: our cloud partner can provide one V100 and one A100 for a 2-hour perf shoot. need time window request by Fri.

tilly: support/usability: can we include a 3-step quickstart in the marketplace card? even a tiny YAML snippet helps.

raj: agree. propose a minimal quickstart:
```
1) install redwood-gw-connector
2) set REDWOOD_KEY
3) run example: python examples/langchain_demo.py
```

maria: add doc link: https://docs.redwood.com/integrations/gateway-langchain. Docs team, please ensure a LlamaIndex-compatible example exists.

olivia: also want a 20-30s perf clip comparing latency on A100 vs V100 for a standard chat scenario. Kai, can you capture that?

kai: i can. will script a deterministic prompt set and record 3 runs each node. will push clips + raw numbers to the shared folder.

arjun: for the certification badge, we need an automated smoke test that verifies: connection, streaming, embeddings, and a retriever flow. propose a CI job that runs against the sandbox image.

raj: i can author the smoke test. needs a stable image tag from Kai and a short runbook.

kai: image tag will be gw-connector-demo:sha256-abc123. pushing Tue 16:00 UTC. registry link: registry.redwood.example/gw-connector-demo:sha256-abc123

chloe: legal question: will any customer data be used in perf clips? we prefer synthetic chat logs.

maria: yes synthetic only. mention that in the marketing assets. add legal-approved disclosure: "Performance clips use synthetic inputs and do not contain customer data."

partner-ops: scheduling conflict: we have maintenance Wed 03:00-05:00 UTC next week. avoid that window for recording and launch.

olivia: publish timeline suggestion: embargoed press + marketplace listing ready 48h before public, internal dry-run 24h prior, publish Wed 17:00 UTC to hit US/EU.

maria: can we get a partner internal dry-run? LangChain and GateMesh ops should join. who owns invites?

arjun: partnerships will schedule. propose Tue 18:30 UTC dry-run.

tilly: make sure support has the minimal troubleshooting doc: common errors + how to reset KV cache and auth tokens. i'll draft it.

raj: add a note: turn off persistent KV cache during demo to avoid cross-demo leakage. record that in runbook.

kai: confirmed demo image disables persistent KV by default. will add a flag to re-enable for internal tests.

maria: ok owners summary:
- marketplace card assets (olivia)
- logo sig + permission (partners) (maria/arjun)
- demo image + perf clips (kai)
- smoke test CI (raj)
- legal disclosures + logo T&C (chloe)
- support runbook + quickstart (tilly)
- schedule dry-run Tue 18:30 (arjun)

olivia: i'm creating the marketing drive folder now and will drop drafts. link when ready.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: reminder: use `announce-publish` pipeline and `announce-rollback` script in case we need to retract. docs for pipelines: infra/announce-runbook.md

maria: thanks everyone. i'll consolidate in the partnership checklist and ping GateMesh + LangChain once we have final assets. updates stay here please. :sparkles:
